meta.gauge_implementation: Vyper 0.2.12 Liquidity Gauge v3 (Curve fork, 'Mobius Finance'); verified source on Blockscout, source sha256(ec0c072bc3ea87bd..) identical for 0xdAA2/0xc96A/0x107F/0x1250; GitHub mobiusAMM/mobi-dao-contracts contracts/gauges/LiquidityGaugeV3.vy

E-U.reason: claim_rewards pays only to _addr / rewards_receiver[_addr]; fresh-address test claimable_reward=0; claim_rewards(any) sim succeeds but moves nothing else
withdraw only own balance; kick only adjusts working_balances; set_rewards/set_killed admin (GaugeProxy) only
guards confirmed via eth_call: notifyRewardAmount only rewardsDistribution, setRewardsDuration/updatePeriodFinish only owner, recoverERC20 blocks staking token; earned(gauge)=0 all RCs
mint sends only msg.sender's accrued MOBI; mint_for needs approval; MOBI.mint restricted to Minter (random-caller sim reverts); MOBI ~$0
withdrawETH() callable by anyone but balance 0; holds no tokens (checked CELO/MOBI/cUSD + Blockscout token list + native)
permissionless in GaugeProxy.vy, but no gauge has a pending future_admin (checked all 27: 22 have future_admin==admin==GaugeProxy -> no-op; 5 have future_admin==0)

H-O.detail: 100% attributed (residual=0) to 300+ claimant addresses across 10 gauges; each recovers own claim_data via claim_rewards()/withdraw(true)
withdrawable only by stakers 1:1 through gauge withdraw(); LP held by StakingRewards (recoverERC20 blocks staking token)
claimable by current holders + exited stakers (residual = stored claim_data)

S.detail: leftover balances in RCs after streams ended; recoverable only by RC owners (recoverERC20 allows reward token: eth_call as owner returns success), else stuck
leftover balances in MOO-gauge reward contracts after streams ended; recoverable only by RC owners (recoverERC20 allows reward token), else stuck
not counted by reward_integral (balance diff only during claim call) -> permanently stuck if ever sent
